title: Indian AI firm backed by Dune and Odyssey visual effects studio valued at $2 billion in fundraise
summary_full: Brahma, an Indian enterprise AI content start-up that is backed by the visual effects studio behind Dune, has raised funds at a $2 billion valuation.
summary_public: Brahma, an Indian enterprise AI content start-up that is backed by the visual effects studio behind Dune, has raised funds at a $2 billion valuation.
